description: List and filter disc golf manufacturers/brands in the database, including active mold counts, speed ranges, category breakdowns, and top popular molds.

category.description: Filter brands that manufacture discs in this category (putter, midrange, fairway_driver, distance_driver)

limit.description: Maximum number of brands to return (1..100, default 20)

min_discs.description: Minimum number of active molds manufactured by the brand

query.description: Search query to match brand name or slug (e.g. 'Axiom', 'Latitude', 'Innova')

name: list_brands
